mission.title: Our Mission
mission.description: We believe every generation has something to give. Through shared activities like art, storytelling, music, cooking, and conversation, we create spaces where seniors share their wisdom and life experience while youth bring curiosity, energy, and companionship. Together, we're building a more connected community, one shared moment at a time.

seniorIsolation.title: Senior Isolation & Loneliness
paragraphs: Many seniors spend long stretches of time alone. Loneliness and social isolation affect physical and mental health, and too many older adults have few chances to share their stories, talents, and experience with others.
Their wisdom, humor, and history are an incredible gift, yet there are few everyday spaces where younger people get to hear it.

youthPurpose.title: Youth Seeking Purpose
paragraphs: Young people want to make a meaningful impact in their communities. They bring energy, creativity, and fresh perspectives, but often lack opportunities to connect with people outside their own age group.
Many youth also miss out on the guidance, perspective, and warmth that come from meaningful intergenerational relationships.

solution.title: Our Solution: Shared Experiences
solution.description: We bring seniors and youth together around activities they both enjoy. Everyone is a contributor: seniors share stories, skills, and life lessons, while youth bring curiosity, energy, and companionship.

faq.question: How much does the program cost?
faq.answer: Our programs are designed to be accessible and affordable. Costs vary based on the type of program and participant needs. Contact us for specific pricing information.

faq.question: Do I need to bring supplies?
faq.answer: No. We provide the art supplies, games, and materials needed for each activity. If you have a favorite recipe, song, photo, or keepsake to share, you're always welcome to bring it.

faq.question: How long are the programs?
faq.answer: Most sessions run about an hour, and you can join weekly for as long as you like. We also host one-time events and seasonal celebrations throughout the year.

faq.question: Do I need any special skills or experience?
faq.answer: Not at all! Every activity is beginner-friendly and adapted to different abilities. Just bring yourself and a willingness to connect.

faq.question: Are sessions in-person or virtual?
faq.answer: Most sessions happen in person at partner facilities and community spaces. Some activities, like Story Circle and Chai & Chat, can also be joined virtually.

faq.question: How are youth volunteers trained?
faq.answer: All youth volunteers complete training on communication, active listening, adapting activities for different abilities, and working with older adults before they are matched with participants.
